questions.q: An extra commission paid by a consignor to a consignee who guarantees payment from credit customers and undertakes to bear any losses resulting from bad debts is known as
questions.explain: **Del credere commission** is an additional commission paid by the principal (consignor) to the agent (consignee). In exchange for this higher fee, the consignee assumes all credit risk; if any credit buyer fails to pay (bad debt), the loss is absorbed by the consignee rather than the consignor.

questions.q: In the books of the consignor, the **Consignment Account** functions primarily as a/an
options: Real account showing the physical inventory located at the agent's warehouse
Personal account reflecting the total debt owed by the consignee
Special Trading and Profit and Loss Account designed to determine the net profit or loss made on that specific consignment
Analytical summary cash book recording remittances
questions.explain: The **Consignment Account** is a nominal account. It is debited with the cost of goods sent and all expenses incurred (by both consignor and consignee), and credited with total sales proceeds and any closing stock at cost. The resulting balance represents the net profit or loss generated by that specific consignment transaction.
